action.reason: Slow spans and dependency hints alone do not prove timeouts or domain faults; query logs to measure observed dependencies and confirm whether the product-catalog latency is caused by a DB slow query or an RPC timeout.

The strongest evidence is a trace.db_slow span (28366.5ms) on the product-catalog path supporting db_slow_query, while the timeout alert and rpc_timeout hint are not yet proven; a DB expert can measure the observed database dependency to confirm or rule out a slow query as the root cause.
